summary: High-quality analysis with accurate codebase research, clear problem articulation, and well-reasoned recommendation. All major technical claims verified against the codebase. Three meaningfully different options are presented with clear trade-offs. Open questions are specific and actionable. One minor inaccuracy: the resilience patterns section attributes RetryWithBackoff and CircuitBreaker to shared/egg_contracts/resilience.py, but CircuitBreaker is in orchestrator/resilience.py and the shared file has RetryConfig rather than RetryWithBackoff. This does not affect the analysis conclusions.
